maintenance.tabDescription: Temporarily block everyone except developers, for example during upgrades or data fixes.
maintenance.onDetail: Everyone except developers is blocked and sees the maintenance screen.
maintenance.offDetail: The app is open for everybody.
maintenance.messageHint: 3 to 300 characters. Keep it friendly and short.
maintenance.messagePlaceholder: We are upgrading CoachEasily SalesOS and will be back shortly.
maintenance.etaHint: Must be in the future. Shown to users and used for the retry hint.
maintenance.etaPast: The expected time must be in the future.
maintenance.confirmBody: Every other user, including Founder and Admin, will immediately see the maintenance screen and cannot use the app until you turn this off. Sign-in and sign-out keep working, and you keep full access.
maintenance.confirmDisableBody: Users will return to the app automatically within about 30 seconds.
maintenance.failOpenNote: Safety: if the state store cannot be reached, the app stays open instead of locking everyone out.
maintenance.loadError: Could not load the maintenance state.
maintenance.bannerText: Maintenance mode is ON. Everyone except developers is blocked.
maintenance.pageBack: We are back. Returning to the app.
